extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources.
extraction.creator: Asbjøm Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora Garc´ıa, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, and Mads Nielsen
extraction.publisher: University of Copenhagen, Pioneer Centre For AI, Copenhagen Research Centre for Biological and Precision Psychiatry, Mental Health Centre Copenhagen, Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Hawkes Institute, University College London, Johns Hopkins University, Radiological AI Testcenter, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen University Hospital
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The FOMO60K dataset is derived from 16 publicly available datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences, and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: FOMO60K is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.
